**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry** into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). 380 commits, 12 things a user sees.

Three need your call:

| Item | Why I flagged it |
|---|---|
| `401` vs `403` on expired token | Listed as Breaking. It was a `fix` commit. |
| `refactor(api): drop the unused v1 export route` | Called unused, but it was public. |
| Node version | Docs and CI moved to 22. `package.json` `engines` never changed. |

I left out perf work. Four real wins, like `perf(api): reuse the parsed schema between requests`. Your shape has no Performance heading. Say the word and I add them.
